decisions.reason: Selecting the Advanced Edition for CRM integration does not change the requirement to configure a LinkedIn lead list in Sales Navigator.
CRM integration capability does not establish any change to the required profile URL type stored in HubSpot.
The Sales Navigator plan switch does not change whether email and LinkedIn chat histories must be visible in HubSpot.
The source concerns direct Sales Navigator-to-CRM integration and does not alter the separate HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method.
The plan selection does not change any HubSpot lead-management features, properties, lists, notes, stages, or task-assignment behavior.
The CRM-integration capability of the selected Sales Navigator plan does not change the automated LinkedIn campaign configured in MeetAlfred.
The switched plan is a Sales Navigator edition, not the separately specified HubSpot Starter subscription, so the HubSpot configuration remains unchanged.
The source does not change the CRM-list workflow or MeetAlfred export behavior for silent-lead follow-up campaigns.
Selecting a Sales Navigator edition with CRM integration does not remove or modify the separate requirement to configure MeetAlfred.
The direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot plan capability does not necessarily alter the separately requested Zapier configuration.
The Sales Navigator plan switch has no entailed effect on the automated email campaign configured through MeetAlfred.
